title: UK Postcode Distance Calculator
description: Estimate the spherical straight-line distance between two representative UK postcode locations.
summary_sentence: The postcode coordinates represent locations, not necessarily individual doorsteps.
quick_answer: The tool uses postcodes.io representative coordinates and calculates spherical great-circle distance, not address-to-address or driving distance. Coverage and input precision depend on the postcode service.

faq: Do I need the full postcode, or is the district enough?

Use the full postcode (for example SW1A 1AA, not just SW1A). The distance is measured between the coordinates postcodes.io publishes for the complete code; a district covers a wide area and would make the answer depend on which point in it you happened to pick.
No. It is a spherical great-circle estimate between representative postcode coordinates, not a road route.
Where do the coordinates come from?

From postcodes.io, the open UK postcode dataset built on Ordnance Survey and ONS data. Each postcode resolves to a representative latitude and longitude, which is what the haversine calculation consumes.
Does it work for Northern Ireland?
postcodes.io may resolve Northern Ireland postcodes. Availability depends on the provider, and results use representative locations.
Why does my result differ from a mileage calculator?

Because they measure different things. Mileage follows roads; this tool measures geometry. The gap between the two grows where roads must detour around water, hills or sparse networks — the comparison itself is often the useful insight.
How accurate is a postcode-to-postcode distance?
It is an estimate between provider-reported representative coordinates, not a measured distance between properties. Coverage, point accuracy and postcode extent vary.
Can I compare many postcodes at once?
This page answers one pair at a time, carefully. For a table of every pair among several places, extract the coordinates and use the Distance Matrix Calculator.
